name: Apple Mac Studio (M5 Max, M5 Ultra) Tech Specs
notes: Apple official tech specs for Mac Studio with M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips. M5 Max: 460GB/s (32-core GPU) or 614GB/s (40-core GPU), up to 128GB unified memory. M5 Ultra: 1.2TB/s memory bandwidth, up to 512GB unified memory. Maximum continuous power 480W.
